plain.li: [ransom] {FACTION} paid the blood price for {LOST}, and {PAWN_nameDef} took it. The oath is laid down.
[ransom] {PAWN_nameDef} has taken {FACTION}'s silver for {LOST}, and calls it an ending rather than vengeance.
[ransom,taken] {FACTION} paid for what they did to {LOST}, and {PAWN_nameDef} has let the matter rest. {LOST} is still out there somewhere.
[ransom,pet] {FACTION} paid for {LOST}, and {PAWN_nameDef} accepted, though {PAWN_pronoun} won't touch the silver. The quarrel is over.
[apology] {FACTION} came to say they were sorry for {LOST}, and {PAWN_nameDef} heard them out. The vendetta is over.
[apology] After a long silence, {PAWN_nameDef} has accepted {FACTION}'s apology for {LOST}.
[apology,taken] {FACTION} said they were sorry for carrying off {LOST}. {PAWN_nameDef} has decided that will have to do.
[apology,pet] Someone of {FACTION} came all this way to say sorry about {LOST}. {PAWN_nameDef} found that was enough.

warm.li: [apology] {PAWN_nameDef} shook hands with {FACTION}'s envoy over {LOST}'s memory, and let the anger go with it.
[ransom] {PAWN_nameDef} took {FACTION}'s blood price for {LOST} and asked that it go to whoever in the colony needs it most. The oath is laid down.

blunt.li: [ransom] {FACTION} paid for {LOST}. {PAWN_nameDef} counted it and said that's that.
[apology] {FACTION} said sorry for {LOST}. {PAWN_nameDef} said fine. It's over.

gloomy.li: [ransom] {PAWN_nameDef} has taken silver for {LOST}, and doesn't feel any lighter for it. But the oath is laid down.
[apology] The people of {FACTION} are sorry for {LOST}. {PAWN_nameDef} believes them, and it doesn't bring {LOST} back.

cold.li: [ransom] {PAWN_nameDef} has accepted fair payment from {FACTION} for {LOST}. The account is closed.
[apology] {PAWN_nameDef} has judged {FACTION}'s apology for {LOST} sufficient, and dropped the matter.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} died with an oath against {FACTION} still open for {LOST}, and {PAWN_nameDef} has taken it up.
[kin] With {OTHER_nameDef} gone, {PAWN_nameDef} has taken up the family's oath, and the debt for {LOST} is still {FACTION}'s to pay.
[partner] {OTHER_nameDef} swore {FACTION} would pay for {LOST}, and died before they did. {PAWN_nameDef} has sworn to finish it.
[friend] {PAWN_nameDef} has taken up {OTHER_nameDef}'s vendetta against {FACTION} for {LOST}, sure that {OTHER_nameDef} would have wanted a friend to carry it.
[taken] {OTHER_nameDef} never got {LOST} back from {FACTION}. {PAWN_nameDef} has sworn to keep trying.
[pet] {OTHER_nameDef} died still owed for {LOST}. {PAWN_nameDef} has taken up the oath, animal or not.

cold.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has inherited {OTHER_nameDef}'s account with {FACTION} for {LOST}, and means to collect.

gloomy.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has picked up {OTHER_nameDef}'s oath against {FACTION} for {LOST}, and it sits heavy.

plain.li: [ransom] They paid for {LOST}. I took it. I keep looking at the purse as if it ought to look different.
[ransom] I've laid down the oath against {FACTION}, and the silver's been counted. I still don't know what to do with it.
[apology] Someone of {FACTION} looked me in the eye and said they were sorry for {LOST}. I didn't know I'd been waiting for that until it came.
[apology] I accepted {FACTION}'s apology for {LOST} today. I think I might sleep tonight.

cold.li: [ransom] The blood price for {LOST} was fair. The matter with {FACTION} is closed.

gloomy.li: [apology] They're sorry about {LOST}. So am I. That doesn't bring anyone back.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} carried this oath against {FACTION} for {LOST} until the end. Now I carry it.
I didn't ask for {OTHER_nameDef}'s vendetta. I took it anyway, because otherwise it would have died with {OTHER_objective}.
[kin] It's a family debt now: {FACTION}, {LOST}, and {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll see it paid.
[friend] {OTHER_nameDef} would have done the same for me. That's the only reason I need.

gloomy.li: Another name to carry against {FACTION}. I wish it were lighter.
